tools.name: Crowdsense_Get_Coin_Historical_Metrics_By_Name
tools.description:
Retrieve  coin´s historical social media metrics by Coin Name
In the case you want to retrieve real time data check "Get Coin Metrics by Name" or "Get Coin Metrics by Ticker"

**Input:** 
-  Date (MM/DD/YYYY HH:HH AM/PM) (Required)
- Security Name: Coin Name (Required)
- TimeFrame: 1d, 1h, 8h (Optional)

**Output:**

- Sentiment
- Sentiment change
- Weighted Sentiment
- Weighted sentiment change
- Followers
- Followers change
- Mentions
- Mentions change
- Security ticker
- Security Name
- TimeFrame
- DataTimeStamp

**Definitions:**

•	Mentions - Number of posts related to the coin in tracked
